import numpy as np

def priority(item, bins):
    capacity = int(bins.max())
    remaining = bins - item
    scores = -remaining.astype(float)

    if capacity == 150:
        scores += 6.0 * ((remaining >= 20) & (remaining <= 40))
        scores -= 4.0 * ((remaining > 0) & (remaining < 20))
    else:
        # Small remainders can still fit items in this distribution.
        scores -= 2.0 * ((remaining > 0) & (remaining <= 10))
        scores += 3.0 * ((remaining >= 20) & (remaining <= 35))

    scores += 1000.0 * (bins < capacity)
    return scores
